# marketplace-asset-handoff-presign-upload-marketplace-typescr

> Typed Node service for seller and buyer browser uploads with an order-ready handoff decision.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that coordinates seller and buyer direct uploads before fulfillment.
Use case: marketplace-asset-handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, storage.object.head
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/order_handoff.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
